description: The declared account's saved-cart list on the store (one row per account), min..max carts. Outputs: savedCartCount, first name and first quantity asc/desc, a cart name not contained in another of its names. KB: Shopping Cart (Saved Carts).

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the saved carts: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minSavedCarts.description: Fewest saved carts the account must own on the store (e.g. 9 for two pages at page size 8)

maxSavedCarts.description: Most saved carts the account may own on the store (e.g. 16 for at most two pages at page size 8)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
